run_train_net_sgd: run the train_net.py script to train a neural network with SGD on CIFAR-10 for 50 epochs
run_train_net_nas: run the train_net.py script to train a NAS architecture with cutout and drop path regularization
run_finetune_darts: run the train_net.py script to fine-tune a DARTS architecture initialized from a GHN checkpoint
run_finetune_pretrained: run the train_net.py script to fine-tune a pretrained torchvision model like ResNet-50 on few-shot data
run_evaluate_only: run the train_net.py script with zero epochs to evaluate a model on the validation set
